title: HostCover Premium Rate Card
content:
**Host Damage Protection (HostCover) premium rates, per stay, by level.**

| HostCover level | Premium rate (percent of the premium base) | Lowest premium on a stay (USD) | Superhost premium discount (percent off) |
|---|---|---|---|
| HostCover Essential | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| HostCover Standard | 1.00 | 2.00 | 25.00 |
| HostCover Plus | 1.50 | 3.00 | 25.00 |
| HostCover Premier | 2.00 | 5.00 | 25.00 |
| HostCover Elite | 2.50 | 8.00 | 25.00 |
| HostCover Estate | 3.00 | 15.00 | 25.00 |

**Terms common to every level**

| Term | Every level |
|---|---|
| Premium base: the stay amounts the rate applies to | the stay's nightly subtotal plus the stay's cleaning fee |
| Premium refund when the stay is refunded | in proportion to the reduction in the stay's premium base from host-funded refunds |
| Premium refunded when the plan is cancelled | No |

Footnotes

1. The lowest premium on a stay is 0.00 on the free level, HostCover Essential.
2. The Superhost premium discount is the percentage taken off the premium for a host whose tier is Superhost on the stay's check-in date. On HostCover Essential the discount is 0.00 percent.
3. "Premium refunded when the plan is cancelled: No" means that cancelling the plan refunds no premium at any level.

Reading the card: on HostCover Elite the rate is 2.50 percent of the stay's nightly subtotal plus cleaning fee, and the lowest premium charged on a stay is 8.00.
